links.outcome: Association of prior AI understanding/exposure with cross-checking LLM output and LLM use
links.effect: Those with some baseline AI understanding or exposure were 5.06 (p=0.021) and 3.38 (p=0.039) times more likely to cross-check LLM information than those with little to none (observational association).
links.quote: Previous AI knowledge and exposure correlated with more conscientious use of these tools such as cross-checking information.

unlisted_practices: Integrating AI education into the medical school curriculum

screen.reason: This is an empirical cross-sectional survey examining medical students' usage patterns, perceptions, and attitudes toward LLMs in medical education and clinical care, but it does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
